VP_VAPOR_map_memory_placed.label: Vapor placed-memory loader-path profile
VP_VAPOR_map_memory_placed.description: Minimal Vulkan Profiles file for the no-GPU loader-path lane: advertises VK_EXT_map_memory_placed with both placed-map feature bits so a Vulkan-Profiles layer can simulate them over the Vulkan-Tools Mock ICD. Used only to model capabilities; the CI fallback route patches the mock ICD directly when the profiles layer is not built.
